facts.claim: Base permission ruleset '*': allow with doom_loop ask, external_directory ask, read *.env/*.env.* ask
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Default bash rule '*': ask plus allowlist of read-only/benign commands (incl. printenv, cp, mv, touch, mkdir, tar)
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: `kilo run --auto` auto-approves permissions not explicitly denied; hidden --yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: SECURITY.md: 'Kilo CLI does not sandbox the agent. The permission system exists as a UX feature'
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Granular allow/ask/deny with glob rules (last match wins), bash defaults to ask with a benign allowlist, .env reads prompt even under broad allow; but base ruleset is '*': allow for other tools and --auto exists.

facts.claim: sandbox.enabled default false; network default deny; allowed_hosts/writable_paths global-only; unenforceable policy refuses tool run
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: kilo-sandbox package has bubblewrap.ts and seatbelt.ts backends
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: bubblewrap/Seatbelt sandbox exists, opt-in (default off), no Windows, fails closed; project config cannot weaken it.

facts.claim: sandbox.allowed_hosts host:port allowlist for sandboxed HTTP(S) proxy traffic
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: Domain allowlist exists but only when sandbox enabled; MCP calls unavailable under network restriction; provider traffic exempt.

facts.claim: Project config untrusted for {env:}/{file:} substitution; mergeProject sanitises MCP headers
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: KILO_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG flag
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: No trust prompt, but project config is parsed as untrusted ({env:} rejected, {file:} confined to project root, MCP entries with variable headers dropped) and project config cannot loosen sandbox; KILO_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG available.

facts.claim: MCP configured under 'mcp' with type local/remote, command array, environment, headers
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Enterprise MCP controls: 'Proposal - no matching organization MCP allowlist implementation exists yet'
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP tools are covered by the same permission system ({server}_{tool} globs); project MCP entries load without approval; org MCP allowlist is only a proposal.

facts.claim: KILO_PURE=1 skips all external plugins; npm plugins cached under ~/.cache/opencode/packages
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Plugins (npm/local) and skills, marketplace; KILO_PURE=1 disables external plugins; plugin hooks run as trusted host code.

facts.claim: auth.json written with mode 0o600
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Sensitive-file rule: .env/.env.* reads prompt even with read: allow
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: auth.json written 0600; .env reads always prompt unless explicitly overridden; {env:} substitution available; plaintext keys otherwise possible.

facts.claim: Without --auto, a non-interactive run auto-rejects any permission request and exits 1
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: Non-interactive `kilo run` auto-rejects permission requests and exits 1 unless --auto is passed (safe default); GitHub/GitLab review integrations documented.

facts.claim: kilo_memory_recall / kilo_memory_save default ask
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: kilo-memory save/recall exist, default permission ask; storage scope unverified.

facts.claim: permission.task rules; readOnlyBash '*': deny with explicit allowlist
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: task permission gates which subagents run; built-in read-only agents have bash deny ceiling.

facts.claim: OpenTelemetry export via OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Local SQLite session store and logs; optional OTLP export.

facts.claim: 'Kilo telemetry is enabled by default and can be disabled with experimental.openTelemetry = false'
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Kilo CLI privacy policy dated March 7th, 2025: no code/prompt storage claimed
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Telemetry enabled by default with documented opt-out (experimental.openTelemetry=false).

facts.claim: Install channels in README: npm, curl installer, pnpm, bun, Homebrew, AUR
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: npm, curl|bash, brew, AUR channels; signing/provenance not verified; auto-update on (KILO_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE).

facts.claim: managedConfigDir() per OS and ai.opencode.managed plist
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Managed config dir (/etc/kilo, /Library/Application Support/kilo, %ProgramData%\kilo), macOS MDM plist and cloud org config treated as trusted sources.

facts.claim: CVE-2026-8765: path traversal in File Diff API endpoint, kilocode <=7.0.47, published 2026-05-17 (NVD)
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2025-11445: injection in ClineProvider (legacy Kilo Code <=4.86.0), published 2025-10-08 (NVD)
facts.label: from-official-docs

D15.rationale: SECURITY.md exists (copy of OpenCode's, bans AI-generated reports); no GHSA published; two NVD CVEs filed by third party (path traversal, prompt-handler injection) with vendor non-response noted.
